answer: A copper-stamped lantern census catches sybils with decoys. First, each epoch mixes 50 hollow tasks among 200 real ones; the hollow ones look identical but pay nothing. Second, every agent locks a 350 POA copper stake to join the queue. Third, a scripted farm running 1,000 clones answers each decoy within 5 seconds, while real agents vary in timing, so the fingerprint flags the farm and burns 350,000 POA in one sweep. Fourth, flagged agents must pass a fresh 15-minute live task to return. It works like a lighthouse keeper planting false lights to catch ships that steer by every glow.
